chapter.verse: Topa tungah lungdamna ko un, bang hang hiam cih leh amah hoih a, ama itna kip kho tawntung hi!
“Ama itna kip kho tawntung hi,” Israelte in ci ta uh hen.
“Ama itna kip kho tawntung hi,” Aaron innkuante in ci ta uh hen.
“Ama itna kip kho tawntung hi,” Topa a zahtakte in ci ta uh hen.
Ka cihmawhna-ah Topa ka sam a, Topa in hong dawng-in mun tanzau-ah hong koih hi.
Topa in kei hong ompih hi; bangmah ka kihta kei ding hi. Mi in kei bang hong cih zo ding ahi hiam?
Kei hong huh dingin kei lamah Topa om hi; kei hong mudahte pen gualzawhna tawh ka en ding hi.
Mi i muan’ sangin Topa belh ding hoihzaw hi.
Uliante i muan’ sangin Topa belh ding hoihzaw hi.
Minam khempeuh in kei hong umcih uh hi; ahih hangin Topa ’ vang tawh amaute ka sugawp hi.
Amaute in kei hong umcih hi, ka kimkot ah hong umcih uh hi; ahih hangin Topa ’ vang tawh amaute ka sugawp hi.
Amaute in khuaipi bangin kei hong umcih uh a, lingkung meikang bangin amaute kuang uh hi; Topa ’ vang tawh amaute ka sugawp hi.
Kei ka puk nadingin nakpi takin hong kisawn a, ahih hangin Topa in kei hong huh hi.
Topa in a vanglian, a thahatin kei hong bawl a, amah in keimah hong honpa ahi hi.
Ngai un! thuman mite’ puanbuk sungah gualzawh lungdamna la kisa a, “ Topa ’ taklam khut in a lian nate hih khin hi!
Topa ’ taklam khut kipahtawi a, Topa ’ taklam khut in a lian nate hih khin hi!” kici hi.
Kei ka si kei ding a, ka hing ding hi; Topa ’ sepnate ka gengen ding hi.
Topa in nasia takin kei hong thuhilh a, ahih hangin kei hong sisak lo hi.
Topa tungah lungdamna ko-in ka lut theih nadingin thumanna kongpite kei hong hon in.
Hih in Topa ’ kongpi ahi hi; thuman mi bek hih kongpi-ah lut ding hi.
Nangmah in kei hong dawngin, ka kihotkhiatna suak khin na hih ciangin nangma tungah ka lungdam hi.
Inn lamte in a nilkhiat suang pen innkiu suang bulpi suak khin ta hi.
Hih in Topa ’ nasepna hi a, eite’ mit-ah lamdang hi.
Hih ni pen Topa hong piak ni hi a, eite lungdamin i kipak ding hi.
Topa aw, kote hong hon in, hong thuum ung! Topa aw, kong thuum uh hi, daupaina hong pia in!
Topa ’ min tawh hong paipa in thupha ngah ta hen! Topa ’ inn panin nang kong phat uh hi.
Topa in Pasian ahi hi; amah in eite tungah nopsakna hong pia zo hi. Na khut uh-ah singhiang tawi-in, biaknatau kimkotin pai un.
Nangmah in keima Pasian na hi a, nangma tungah lungdamna kong ko ding hi; nangmah in keima Pasian na hi a, nangmah kong phat ding hi.
Topa ’ tungah lungdamna ko un, bang hang hiam cih leh amah hoih a, ama itna kip kho tawntung hi.
